newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Mayban Property Trust public issue oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Mayban Property Trust public issue oversubscribed.

text.p: The public issue of three million units of Mayban Property Trust Fund One (MPTF-1) at an issue price of 1.28 ringgit a unit was heavily oversubscribed, issuing house MIDFCCS Sdn Bhd said on Wednesday.
"A total of 181,028 applications for 342.8 million units were received from the Malaysian public," MIDFCCS director Darwis Mohd Daek was quoted as saying by the national Bernama news agency.
The property trust units are expected to be listed on the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange's main board in mid-March.
For the listing exercise, the fund also offered 9.0 million units for private placement apart from the 3.0 million units for public subscription.
The fund is managed by Mayban Property Trust Management Bhd, which is part of the Malayan Banking group.
As required by the Securities Commission, MPTF-1 has to invest at least 80 percent of the fund value in property.
The fund currently has four buildings.

Mayban Property Trust Management chairman Mohamed Basir Ahmad told reporters after the balloting that the company would acquire a fifth building in Kuala Lumpur, Bernama said. A sixth property was expected to be acquired overseas, he added.
